desc: Prove the equivalence between `lcm(a, b) <= threshold` and the existence of a common multiple `m <= threshold` usable for sieve-based unions.
Design the DSU representation and decide whether to index by original array positions or numeric values up to `threshold`.
Implement the proxy-node sieve DSU solution in the required `Solution.countComponents` signature.
Validate the implementation on both provided samples and edge cases: values greater than threshold, `1`, no active values, and all values exceeding threshold.
